title: Measure the codex workspace-write sandbox
lead: S01 never exercised codex's write block (the old #54 context says so). Before ork trusts -s workspace-write, measure it with a small spike: are writes outside the worktree and into the main checkout blocked, is .git writable, does resume keep workspace-write (the resume help lists no -s flag), and can sockets bind (known: no). This is a paid call: ask the owner for the call budget before running.
